acceptanceCriteria.text: A successful createRally immediately shows one rally march with the departing hero and troop team and exact wait timer
getRallyById enriches only the player's created rally with target name/level and estimated travel and return durations from versioned route configuration
Later getMarches route timestamps replace estimated leg ETA and cancellation removes the rally, without duplicate badges
Tooltip distinguishes exact and estimated times; tests, docs, build and validation pass

checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Inspect new createRally/getRallyById data and route configuration. 2. Project compact rally actions and merge with march snapshots by squad/rally ID. 3. Expand tooltip to show target, team, wait, outbound and return legs with estimate labels. 4. Add tests and documentation, verify and commit locally.
checkpointPayload.title: Enrich rally marches with target team and leg times
